title: Elysia coupon redemption
context: Coupon redemption under concurrent load (Postgres, READ COMMITTED). A coupon may be used at most max_uses times and once per user. Codes are case-insensitive and stored upper-case. A user may only cancel their own redemptions. `sql` is a postgres.js tagged-template client; sql.begin runs a transaction.
code: export const coupons = new Elysia({ prefix: "/coupons" })
const [coupon] = await tx`SELECT id, max_uses, uses, expires_at FROM coupons WHERE code = ${code}`;
if (coupon.expires_at && coupon.expires_at < new Date()) { set.status = 410; return { error: "expired" }; }
if (coupon.uses > coupon.max_uses) { set.status = 409; return { error: "fully redeemed" }; }
const [dup] = await tx`SELECT 1 FROM redemptions WHERE coupon_id = ${coupon.id} AND user_id = ${user.id}`;
await tx`UPDATE coupons SET uses = uses + 1 WHERE id = ${coupon.id}`;
await tx`INSERT INTO redemptions (coupon_id, user_id) VALUES (${coupon.id}, ${user.id})`;
}, { body: t.Object({ code: t.String({ minLength: 3, maxLength: 32 }) }) })
SELECT r.id, c.code, r.created_at FROM redemptions r
JOIN coupons c ON c.id = r.coupon_id
WHERE r.user_id = ${user.id} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC`;
const rows = await tx`DELETE FROM redemptions WHERE id = ${params.id} RETURNING coupon_id`;
await tx`UPDATE coupons SET uses = uses - 1 WHERE id = ${rows[0].coupon_id}`;

expected.why: not upper-cased, so lower-case input never matches the stored codes
no FOR UPDATE, so concurrent redemptions read the same uses value and exceed max_uses
> allows one redemption beyond max_uses; must be >=
no user_id = ${user.id} filter, so any user can cancel anyone's redemption
